responsibility: Implements target-specific expansion of string and block memory operations for the RISC-V backend. It emits optimized RTL sequences for operations such as strcmp/strncmp/strlen-style byte scanning and memory compare/set, choosing between scalar instruction sequences that exploit bitmanip helpers like `orc.b` and vectorized RVV implementations for suitable fixed-size memory operations, so this file is the backend’s procedural lowering layer for inline stringop expansion rather than general instruction patterns.
